name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y build-essential; if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo xargs apt-get install -y < packages.txt; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; fi; pip3 install --user streamlit; python3 -c 'from preprocessing import ensure_nltk_data; print("NLTK missing:", ensure_nltk_data())' || true; python3 verify_setup.py || true; echo 'Setup finished - see the verification report above'
